title: QORA Autonomous AI Scientist Nearly Doubles Spin Coherence in Real Diamond NV Centers
whyItMatters: Closes the full theory-to-experiment loop on physical diamond spin-1 NV centers, autonomously discovering pulse sequences (AID-ROD-1/2) that nearly double spin coherence time over human SOTA.
summary: Washington University in St. Louis physicists built QORA, a multi-agent AI scientist powered by GPT-6 Astra and Sorol that autonomously calibrates microwave/optical hardware, proposes hypotheses, runs simulations, and executes real experiments on a bulk diamond (DNV-B14) spin-1 nitrogen-vacancy ensemble. Without human sequence design, QORA discovered AID-ROD-1 (T2 = 18.6 ± 0.7 μs) and AID-ROD-2 (T2 = 19.3 ± 1.0 μs), nearly doubling measured coherence time over the human-engineered DROID-C3PO benchmark (9.8 ± 1.1 μs) and uncovering a hierarchical 18-pulse block mechanism that suppresses quadratic onsite disorder.
technicalHighlights: Closed the complete autonomous loop—from theoretical Hamiltonian reasoning to live microwave pulse synthesis and optical readout—on real diamond NV-center hardware.
Discovered AID-ROD-1 (18.6 ± 0.7 μs) and AID-ROD-2 (19.3 ± 1.0 μs), nearly doubling T2 over state-of-the-art human-designed DROID-C3PO (9.8 ± 1.1 μs).
Revealed a new hierarchical 18-pulse decoupling mechanism suppressing quadratic onsite crystal-field disorder D_i(S_i^z)^2 alongside dipolar interactions.
caveats: Published as a November 2026 arXiv preprint (arXiv:2611.21765) awaiting formal peer review, though backed by direct physical laboratory measurements on DNV-B14 diamond.

scoreRationale.foundational: Discovers a genuinely new physical decoupling mechanism for interacting spin-1 ensembles and nearly doubles experimental coherence time.
scoreRationale.ripple: Provides a template for closed-loop LLM scientists directly operating quantum sensors, simulators, and solid-state qubit hardware.
scoreRationale.verification: Experimentally validated on physical bulk-diamond NV centers against DROID-C3PO, pending formal journal peer review.
scoreRationale.velocity: Autonomously calibrated optics/microwaves and discovered superior multi-pulse blocks far faster than manual Floquet engineering.
